high_level_description: This image is a promotional post for a Netflix documentary film titled "Modern Masters: S.S. Rajamouli." The post is shared by the official Netflix India account (@netflix_in) on Instagram. Image Content: The central focus of the image is a portrait of S.S. Rajamouli, a renowned filmmaker, with a warm smile and a beard. Behind him, there is a dynamic and dramatic collage of imagery depicting scenes from his films, including action sequences, characters in intense moments, and fiery explosions, suggesting the epic nature of his work.
